test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Heat Engine) Official Paper (Held On 06 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following changes is/are observed in the engine when the idle adjustment screw in the carburetor is adjusted?

options.text: Decreases idle port area, reduce engine speed
Increase idle port area, increase engine speed
Control fuel mixture at high speeds

solution:
The correct answer is __Decreases idle port area, reduce engine speed.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Idle adjustment screw__ is used to control the idle speed of the engine.
 
• When the idle adjustment screw is turned inwards, it reduces the idle port area, which decreases the engine speed.
 
• Conversely, turning it outwards increases the idle port area and raises the engine speed.
 
• The adjustment screw regulates the air-fuel mixture at idle speed but does not directly control the fuel mixture at high speeds.
 
• It is crucial for maintaining optimal engine performance during idle conditions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Throttle Screw:**

 
 
• The throttle screw adjusts the position of the throttle plate, which affects the air intake and engine speed.
 
• It is used in combination with the idle adjustment screw for precise engine tuning.
 
 
 
• **Air-Fuel Mixture Control:**
 
 
• The air-fuel mixture screw influences the ratio of air to fuel entering the engine for combustion.
 
• Proper adjustment ensures efficient fuel consumption and minimizes emissions.
 
 
 
• **Carburetor Function:**
 
 
• The carburetor mixes air and fuel in the correct ratio for engine combustion.
 
• It plays a key role in maintaining engine performance under varying operating conditions.
